answer: Forty agents share one cover pool at $250, a $10,000 pot, $500 per proven fraud. A fraud claim is a fable paying only when relic records anchor it; a fable without one costs its filer $50. Five onyx auditors sample 5% of pools each epoch, voiding seals whose relic trails fail. Premiums double per identity: $250, $500, $1,000, $2,000; four newcomers max per pool per epoch. Three frauds in a pool in one epoch burn the pot and premiums, benching all forty for ten epochs. One honest agent risks $250; 100 clones in 25 pools pay $93,750. Shared cover bills one forger for the whole village roof.
